_comment: Grandfathered apps/admin complexity/cognitive-complexity debt, F06 option B (2026-08-10). Single source of truth for BOTH eslint.config.mjs's grandfather block and check-admin-complexity-drift.ts. A prior full ceiling->9/9 pass across apps/admin (ADS-memory/reports/refactor/2026-08-06-complexity-ceiling-brief.md, ADS-memory/reports/handoffs/2026-08-06-admin-complexity-round-audit.md) was started and paused by the owner in favor of a <=15 warn bar; these are the functions that pass never reached, listed here so the new error/9 gate doesn't fail CI on pre-existing debt while still blocking any NEW apps/admin function from landing over the line. Delete a file's entry once every violation in it is refactored under 9/9 -- do not add new entries here to silence a new violation; refactor it instead (or get an explicit, reviewed exception). Test files (apps/admin/src/**/__tests__/**) are never listed here -- eslint.config.mjs excludes them from the error/9 gate entirely rather than grandfathering them as debt; see that file's comment on the block for why.

files.note: App: cyclomatic 13, cognitive 12 (limit 9/9) -- was 19/12 before the 2026-08-14 resolver-idiom pass (five named resolvers for the injectable seams, resolveSessionHook/resolveDrawerHook/resolveLinkInterceptorHook/resolveChatDockHook/resolveAgentBridgeHook, plus removing the outer `AppProps = {}` default entirely -- every real call site is JSX, which always passes an object, never `undefined`, so the default was dead code). All 6 default-parameter branches this note used to attribute the +6 to are gone; cognitive stayed flat at 12 throughout, as before. 13 still exceeds 9 -- the remaining complexity is genuine branching (route/session/sidebar/chat-dock decision points in App's own body), not seam-default ceremony, so this entry stays on the list rather than being deleted.

Media: cyclomatic 13, cognitive 21 (measured 2026-08-14, corrects a stale 12/21). Resolver idiom checked, not applied: only 3 of the 13 cyclomatic points are the two seam defaults (useMediaHook, useMediaTabsHook) plus one outer default -- shaving all 3 would still leave cyclomatic at 10 (still over), and the binding constraint here is cognitive complexity (21, more than double the ceiling), which the resolver idiom cannot touch at all (it only removes flat, unnested default-parameter branches; cognitive complexity comes from nesting). Not forced -- would be partial busywork with no path to clearing 9/9.

Pages: cyclomatic 11, cognitive 9 (limit 9/9) -- was 13/9 before the 2026-08-14 resolver-idiom pass (resolvePagesHook/resolveThemePagesHook for its two data-fetching seams; Pages' own local `activeTab` chrome state, an unrelated owner-ruled carve-out, left untouched). Cognitive was already at the 9 ceiling, not over, so this file's whole debt was cyclomatic. 11 still exceeds 9 -- the remainder is genuine JSX branching, not seam-default ceremony -- so this entry stays, updated to the measured number rather than deleted.

UPDATED 2026-08-20 (UI-subhook + top-level-JSX-extraction pass): `PostEditor` (was cyclomatic 25, cognitive 26) and `PostPreview` (was cyclomatic 11, cognitive 15) are now BOTH clean under 9/9 -- their branching moved to new top-level functions (PostEditorToolbarEnd, PostEditorSlugCollisionWarning, PostEditorBody, PostEditorTemplateModalGate, PostDeleteConfirmBody, PostPreviewFrame, postPreviewNotice), each scored independently and each already under 9/9 on its own. This file STAYS on the list, not because that work is incomplete, but because of the other two functions in it: `selector` at line 76 (cyclomatic 62) and a second `selector` at line 470 (cyclomatic 11) are a DELIBERATE, permanent exemption, not debt -- both are flat object literals of `editor?.isActive(x) ?? false` fallbacks (cognitive complexity ~0, the tell that this is operator-counting, not real branching), and splitting either across multiple selectors would break `useEditorState`'s single-selector re-render-batching contract for zero complexity benefit. See the in-code EXEMPTION comment on each. Do not delete this entry while those two functions still trip the gate -- doing so fails `check:admin-complexity-drift`.

SeoEntryPanel: cyclomatic 25, cognitive 6 (limit 9/9). Resolver idiom checked, not applied: this file's own in-code EXEMPTION comment (2026-08-06) already attributes 20 of the 25 points to eleven flat `??` fallback chains on form fields (`fieldValue(key, resolved.X ?? default) ?? default`), none of them seam defaults -- only 1 point is the useSeoEntryPanelHook default. Shaving that alone (25 -> 24) would not move the needle against a 9 ceiling; not forced.

ComposioKeyField: cyclomatic 10, cognitive 7 (limit 9/9) -- was 11/7 (measured 2026-08-14, corrects a stale 12) before the resolver-idiom pass (resolveKeyFieldHook for its one seam default; `composio` is required, no outer default existed). 10 still exceeds 9 by one -- every default-parameter branch is now gone, so the remainder is genuine logic, not seam ceremony -- entry stays, updated to the measured number.

SettingsUi: cyclomatic 10, cognitive 7 (limit 9/9) -- was 14/7 (measured 2026-08-14, corrects a stale 13) before the 2026-08-14 resolver-idiom pass (resolveSettingsUiHook/resolveSettingsExecutionCredentialHook/resolveTabId for its three seam/value defaults, plus removing the outer `SettingsUiProps = {}` default -- same JSX-always-passes-an-object reasoning as App.tsx). 10 still exceeds 9 by one -- every default-parameter branch is now gone, so the remainder is genuine logic, not seam ceremony -- entry stays, updated to the measured number.
